title: Grilled Kenyan Nimble Biryani
description: A unique fusion dish that combines the flavors of Kenya and India with a nimble twist. This biryani is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Biryani Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the diced beetroot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked nimble, biryani spice blend, and uncooked rice to the pan.
Mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
